results.title: A playlist as the old reader has it
results.checks: Make a playlist; Edit playlist gives it a new title and a description; with it open, choosing John 3:16 offers Add to Playlist in the verse toolbar; Move down; Play, then close the Library: Save and Bookmark leave the chapter header, the bar shows Stop · Previous · the item · Next, and a note beside the reading says '1 of 2' with Next →, ✕ folds it to Show note; Next to the last item and Finish says 'You've reached the end of …'; Delete asks 'Delete playlist?'
results.note: renamed with a description, John 3:16 added from the verse toolbar and moved, played in the reader 1 of 2 (Save and Bookmark stepped aside; the bar showed Stop, Previous, the item and Next) → 2 of 2 → finished, deleted after the check

results.title: Guided tour
results.checks: A ?tutorial=introduction link opens the tour; Next walks every step to Done and the tour closes; ?tutorialStep=2 (zero-based, as in the old reader) starts on step 3; Escape closes it
results.note: 5 steps walked to Done; a link with tutorialStep=2 opened on 3 of 5; Escape closed it
